Photo 1 shows the closed lid of the laptop, silver in color, with the HP logo centered. A white sticker with specifications is visible in the top right corner.

The sticker in photo 1 lists: 'Model: 14-df0000ng', 'Processor: Intel Core i5-10210U', 'Memory: 8GB DDR4', 'Storage: 256GB SSD', 'Display: 13.3" FHD Touchscreen', 'Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620', 'OS: Windows 10 Pro'.
The laptop appears to be in used condition with minor scuffs on the side (photo 0) and some wear on the lid (photo 1).
No screen or keyboard backlight is visible in the photos. The screen is off, so touch functionality cannot be confirmed visually.
